name: railing_open
note: Open-bar balcony / landing / stoop railing: bottom rail plate + N posts + top rail plate, and NO infill web. dims = [length, height, depth]. This is the railing the M2 brief's inventory actually asked for; it only became authorable in M6, when `alignU` gave a child a way to butt its edge to a point on the face's u axis. The top rail is a child of the FIRST post (a 0.06 m parent), and `alignU: "start"` is what lets a 2.4 m plate hang off it and still span the declared box exactly. `instance: 0` keeps it on post 0 — per-instance children are the default, and without it the top rail would be repeated once per post. The posts run edge to edge for the same reason. `railing` (the web version) is kept unchanged beside it: it is what the frozen M2 baseline references, and a web still reads better than bars at a distance where the gaps go sub-pixel (V5 will say so).
